sources.title: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct weight repository; Apache-2.0 license; text/image/video understanding; visual agent and tool capabilities; distinguishes Instruct from Thinking editions.

sources.evidence: Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration; qwen3_vl_moe; 94 text layers, 128 experts and 8 experts per token; max_position_embeddings 262144; separate vision configuration. Retrieved directly after the browser fetch failed.

sources.title: Official Qwen3-VL repository release announcement and examples
sources.evidence: News entry dated 2025-09-23 explicitly announces the exact Instruct and Thinking checkpoints. Identifies Alibaba Cloud Qwen team and demonstrates video inputs for this exact Instruct checkpoint.

sources.title: Exact official checkpoint safetensors metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Qwen-owned repository
sources.evidence: safetensors.total and BF16 parameter count both report 235670022896 stored parameters for the complete checkpoint, about 235.67B; the model page rounds this to 236B.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report, section 2
sources.evidence: Describes separate LLM, vision encoder and mergers. The Large Language Model subsection reports nominal 235B total and 22B activated per token for the flagship. Describes separate non-thinking and thinking variants.

sources.title: Exact Instruct checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Handles supplied tool definitions, function-name/arguments tool calls and tool responses, plus image and video content. Plain assistant generation prompt supports the Instruct variant distinction.

name.note: Baseline is a readable rendering of exact checkpoint name Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud.

release_date.note: Explicit developer release announcement for this exact open checkpoint; repository creation is not treated as release.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable checkpoint with safetensors weights.

parameters_b.note: Full stored checkpoint count: 235670022896 / 1e9. Includes vision and mergers; 235B is the nominal language-backbone designation rather than the precise multimodal total.

active_parameters_b.note: Published nominal activated parameters per token in the report's LLM subsection. This is the language-path count, not a measured aggregate for image/video encoder and merger execution; no full multimodal active scalar is established.

architecture.note: MoE language decoder with 128 experts and 8 selected per token, plus vision encoder and projection/DeepStack mergers.

context_window.note: Native configured maximum; 1M requires length-extrapolation settings and is not the default.

modalities.note: Video support is present in exact-checkpoint examples and template. No audio modality established.

reasoning.note: Instruct is the non-thinking edition; false denotes absence of the dedicated Thinking mode, not inability to perform visual reasoning.

tool_call.note: Official exact-checkpoint template explicitly supports tools and tool-call/response serialization.

description.value: Qwen vision-language instruct model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: The existing description is supported by model-card capabilities without benchmark or superlative claims.

patch.notes: Full checkpoint metadata reports 235.670022896B stored parameters including vision and mergers. The 235B-A22B designation and reported 22B active-per-token figure describe nominal language-backbone scale; 22B does not establish a complete multimodal activation count. Instruct is the non-thinking edition.

summary: Confirmed exact release date and MoE architecture. Correct full checkpoint count from nominal 235B to 235.670022896B, add Apache-2.0, correct native context to 262144, and add video input. Retain published nominal 22B language-path active count with explicit scope caveat; no full multimodal active count established. Other fields supported.
